lint.note: golangci-lint v2.8.0 was built with go1.25.4 but the project targets go1.26.1. This is an environment toolchain version mismatch, not a code issue. No code changes were made in this docs-only milestone. The lint would pass with a golangci-lint binary built with go1.26.1.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: The tui-docs-worker skill instructs workers to cite specific symbols but does not provide guidance on verifying line numbers. Two features (docs-audit-current-tui, docs-adrs) produced systematically approximate line-number citations. The skill should add a step: 'use grep -n or rg --line-number to verify each citation line number before writing it'.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: docs-audit-current-tui review found 21/23 spot-checked citations off by 1-118 lines. docs-adrs review found 2 slightly imprecise citations. The skill says 'cite specific symbols' but not 'verify line numbers'.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: The tui-docs-worker skill says to cross-reference against keys.go for keybinding conflicts but does not mention shell.gsx. The docs-information-architecture worker correctly discovered shell.gsx bindings independently via Grep. The skill should mention shell.gsx as a required source for keybinding conflict analysis.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: docs-information-architecture review found that shell.gsx:269-299 contains important keybindings (FocusGroup Tab/Shift-Tab, rail tabs, cycleRail) not in keys.go. The skill's precondition only lists keys.go.
